# StudReads

StudReads is a web application that parses university timetable spreadsheets (Excel format .xlsx and .xls) and generates interactive, conflict-free visual weekly schedules. Users can filter courses by section, add custom/additional electives, customize color codes, resolve schedule overlaps, and export finalized timetables as high-resolution images or shareable links. All data processing occurs locally within the browser.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://university-timetable-gen.vercel.app/): Upload a spreadsheet and generate your timetable
- [Privacy Policy](https://university-timetable-gen.vercel.app/#privacy): How user data is handled (client-side only)
- [Contact / Support](https://university-timetable-gen.vercel.app/#contact): Reach the developer

## Core Features

- Heuristic Excel timetable parser (client-side via xlsx library)
- Section-aware course filtering and selection
- Conflict detection and visual highlighting
- Color customization with preset themes
- Export to high-resolution PNG image
